han: 7.2.70 selects iṭ before sya. The commentaries independently contrast hantā and haniṣyati.
so: The regular future base sā- retains the long vowel; the initial s alone retroflexes after qualifying ni. The second s of sāsyati follows ā in this combination.
observed_and_composed: The root futures haniṣyati and hantā are explicitly quoted; the two ordered prefix schedules here are rule-backed extensions.
